test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct about plant's response to environmental stimulus?

options.text: Plants have very weak muscles to respond environmental stimulus.
Plants have special connective tissues to receive environmental stimulus.
Some plants can respond to the stimulus of touch.
Plants have very fine nerves to receive environmental stimulus.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Some plants can respond to the stimulus of touch.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Plants exhibit response to stimuli** through movements called **tropisms** or nastic movements. One of the most well-known examples is the response to touch, known as **thigmonasty**.
 
• The classic example of this is the **Touch-Me-Not plant (Mimosa pudica)**. When touched, its leaves fold and droop due to changes in **turgor pressure** in the cells.
 
• Unlike animals, plants **lack muscles and nervous systems**. Their responses are driven by biochemical and physiological changes.
 
• Some plants also exhibit touch-sensitive responses for survival purposes, such as trapping insects. For instance, the **Venus flytrap** closes its lobes upon sensing prey via hair-like structures.
 
• **Thigmotropism** is another form of touch response, where plants like climbing vines use tendrils to wrap around supporting structures.
